Utility functions:

```{r}
load_data <- function(dir_name, metric) {
  file_path <- paste0(base_path, dir_name, "/", metric, ".csv")
  return(read.csv(file_path))
}

load_name <- function(dir_name) {
  file_path <- paste0(base_path, dir_name, "/", "info", ".yaml")
  return(yaml.load_file(file_path)$name)
}

load_iter_times <- function(dir_name) {
  file_path <- paste0(base_path, dir_name, "/", "info", ".yaml")
  times <- yaml.load_file(file_path)$iter_times
  if (is.null(times)) {
    times <- 1
  }
  return(times)
}

process_data <- function(data, iteration_times, interval) {
  if (!is.numeric(iteration_times) || iteration_times <= 0) {
    stop("iteration_times must be a positive integer")
  }

  processed_data <- data %>%
    mutate(evaluation = row_number() * iteration_times) %>%
    filter(evaluation %% interval == 0) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      mean = mean(c_across(-c(evaluation)), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd = sd(c_across(-c(evaluation)), na.rm = TRUE),
      upper = mean + 1.96 * sd / sqrt(length(na.omit(c_across(-c(evaluation))))),
      lower = mean - 1.96 * sd / sqrt(length(na.omit(c_across(-c(evaluation)))))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(evaluation, mean, upper, lower)
  
  return(processed_data)
}
```

```{r}
names <- list()

accu_sla_all <- list()
accu_reconf_all <- list()
se_all <- list()

for (i in seq_along(directories)) {
  dir <- directories[i]

  res <- try({
    name <- load_name(dir)
  })
  if (inherits(res, "try-error")) {
    name <- dir
  }

  if (name %in% names) {
    name <- paste0(name, "-", dir)
  }

  names[[i]] <- name

  iteration_times <- load_iter_times(dir)

  sla_vio_data <- load_data(dir, "accu_sla")
  reconf_data <- load_data(dir, "accu_reconf")
  se_data <- load_data(dir, "average_se")

  sla_vio_stats <- process_data(sla_vio_data, iteration_times, interval)
  reconf_stats <- process_data(reconf_data, iteration_times, interval)
  se_stats <- process_data(se_data, iteration_times, interval)

  sla_vio_stats$source <- name
  reconf_stats$source <- name
  se_stats$source <- name

  accu_sla_all[[i]] <- sla_vio_stats
  accu_reconf_all[[i]] <- reconf_stats
  se_all[[i]] <- se_stats
}

accu_sla_all <- do.call(rbind, accu_sla_all)
accu_reconf_all <- do.call(rbind, accu_reconf_all)
se_all <- do.call(rbind, se_all)
```


set color:
```{r}
simulate_alpha <- function(color, alpha) {
  rgb_vals <- grDevices::col2rgb(color) / 255
  blended_rgb <- (1 - alpha) * 1 + alpha * rgb_vals
  grDevices::rgb(blended_rgb[1], blended_rgb[2], blended_rgb[3], maxColorValue = 1)
}
main_colors <- pal_npg("nrc", alpha = 1)(4)
main_colors <- setNames(main_colors, names)
# fill_colors <- sapply(main_colors, function(color) simulate_alpha(color, 0.2))
fill_colors <- pal_npg("nrc", alpha = 0.2)(4)
fill_colors <- setNames(fill_colors, names)

print(main_colors)
print(fill_colors)
```

```{r}
slap = ggplot(data = accu_sla_all, aes(x = evaluation, y = mean, color = source)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = source), color = NA) +
  geom_line(size=0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = main_colors) +
  labs(x = "Steps",
       y = "SLA violation times") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.3, 0.8),   # scen 3 / 4
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),

    text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 22),

    legend.text = element_text(size = 30)
    ) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

# ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "rew.pdf"), plot = slap, width = 6, height = 5, device = "pdf")
ggsave(paste0(plot_path, "sla.pdf"), plot = slap, width = 6, height = 5, device = "pdf")
```
